problem.title: Check Whether Two Insertion Sequences Produce the Same Binary Search Tree
problem.problemStatement: Given two sequences of distinct keys inserted into initially empty Binary Search Trees, determine whether both insertion sequences produce identical Binary Search Trees without explicitly constructing both trees.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the first insertion sequence. • The third line contains the second insertion sequence.
problem.output: • Print YES if both sequences generate identical BSTs; otherwise print NO.
